verdict.rationale: Adyen's manage-cards docs cover activating, suspending (pausing) and permanently closing cards. Cards are paymentInstrument resources updated via /paymentInstruments/{id}, so the core status lifecycle appears API-driven. Unpausing is only implied by suspend being temporary, and lost-card reporting appears only in the context of the Raise disputes API rather than as a card-status action. missing for 10: explicit unpause/reactivate API, a dedicated lost/stolen card-status operation, reissue with a replacement linked to the original card, explicit API references for each status transition, independent corroboration.
